summary: The Denza N8 has opened for pre-orders with a 1,003 km electric range, while a wave of new models — including the Qin PLUS DM-i, Binyue Super Edition, Fulwin A9 Extended-Range, and Jetour Shanhai L7 PLUS Intelligent Driving Edition — have hit the market in quick succession, keeping price and smart-driving competition heating up.

articles.title: 1,003 km Electric Range: Denza Opens Bookings for Its Large Five-Seat SUV, the N8
articles.summary: Denza has officially opened bookings for the N8, a large five-seat SUV boasting a 1,003 km electric range, targeting the premium segment.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, Denza has officially begun taking reservations for its all-new large five-seat SUV, the N8. Its biggest highlight is a pure-electric range of 1,003 km, pushing the model straight into the 1,000-km-plus club. Range anxiety remains a core pain point for buyers in the premium electric SUV market, and the N8's figure significantly raises the competitive bar. As a premium brand born from the BYD-Benz partnership, Denza has been steadily expanding its lineup in recent years with models such as the D9, N7 and N8. The N8 now takes on the family-user segment with its spacious five-seat layout, combining roominess, luxury and long range. The launch of bookings signals that the official market debut is drawing near, as Denza looks to capture growth in the premium electric SUV segment during the fourth-quarter sales window. From an industry perspective, 1,000-km pure-electric range is moving from concept to mass production, with advances in battery energy density and energy consumption management finally paying off in end products.
articles.impact: By pushing the range benchmark beyond 1,000 km, the Denza N8 intensifies competition among premium large five-seat electric SUVs and will force rivals to accelerate upgrades in range and luxury experience.

articles.title: Third-Gen BYD Qin PLUS DM-i Launched From RMB 76,900 With Lower Fuel Consumption and Larger Footprint
articles.summary: BYD launches the third-generation Qin PLUS DM-i from RMB 76,900, upgrading both fuel efficiency and cabin space.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, BYD has officially launched the third-generation Qin PLUS DM-i, priced from RMB 76,900. While keeping the plug-in hybrid sedan price-competitive, the new model delivers dual upgrades in fuel consumption and exterior dimensions. The QinPLUS series has long ranked among China's best-selling sedans and serves as a volume pillar for BYD. Its DM-i super hybrid system, which operates primarily on electric power with the engine as backup, delivers running costs far below comparable gasoline rivals. Improvements in energy efficiency and interior space in the third generation further strengthen its dominance in the RMB 70,000–100,000 family sedan segment. The RMB 76,900 starting price also signals an accelerating shift from gasoline sedans to plug-in hybrids at this price point. Amid intensifying price competition, BYD continues to squeeze costs through economies of scale and a vertically integrated supply chain, enabling mainstream buyers to access new-energy technology at a lower entry threshold.
articles.impact: A plug-in hybrid family sedan starting at RMB 76,900 will further squeeze gasoline rivals in the segment and accelerate the rise of new-energy penetration in the A-class sedan market.

articles.title: 2027 Geely Binyue Super Edition Debuts With Introductory Price From RMB 59,800
articles.summary: The 2027 Geely Binyue Super Edition launched on October 27 with an introductory price from RMB 59,800, targeting value-conscious compact SUV buyers.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the 2027 Geely Binyue Super Edition officially launched on October 27 at an introductory price from RMB 59,800, following the earlier release of official images. As one of Geely's volume models in the compact SUV segment, the Binyue series targets young first-time buyers. This Super Edition lowers the entry barrier further through aggressive pricing. At RMB 59,800, it drops directly into the RMB 50,000–60,000 price band, competing head-on with rival Chinese-brand compact SUVs and low-priced new-energy models. With new-energy vehicles rapidly moving downmarket, Geely has opted to defend its gasoline compact SUV base through a facelift combined with a pricing strategy. The Binyue has already been exported to Southeast Asia and other overseas markets, making it an important part of Geely's global lineup. Changes to the new model's product strengths will also affect its overseas competitiveness.
articles.impact: The RMB 59,800 starting price offers budget-conscious first-time buyers a new option and will intensify the battle for share in the low-priced SUV market.

articles.title: 230km Electric Range: Chery Fulwin A9 EREV Launches at RMB 116,900 in Limited-Time Trade-In Offer
articles.summary: Chery Fulwin A9 extended-range version hits the market with 230km of pure-electric range and a limited-time trade-in price from RMB 116,900.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, Chery's Fulwin A9 extended-range electric vehicle (EREV) has entered the market, offering 230km of pure-electric range at a limited-time trade-in price from RMB 116,900. A 230km electric range means most users can drive on pure electric power in daily commuting scenarios, while the range extender covers longer trips — a core selling point of EREV technology at the current stage. The Fulwin series carries Chery's mission to break upward in the new-energy sedan market. The A9 EREV, priced at RMB 116,900 under the trade-in program, targets the RMB 110,000–150,000 plug-in hybrid sedan heartland, going head-to-head with popular models such as the BYD Han and Geely Galaxy. The debate between EREV and plug-in hybrid technology routes continues, and Chery is responding with a long-range EREV solution that addresses both the demand for low-cost commuting and range anxiety. It also reflects the fact that trade-in subsidies and limited-time discounts remain automakers' primary tools for stimulating terminal sales.
articles.impact: The combination of 230km pure-electric range and a RMB 116,900 trade-in price will intensify the battle for plug-in hybrid and extended-range users in the mid-size new-energy sedan market.

articles.title: JETOUR Shanhai L7 PLUS Smart-Driving Edition Launched From RMB 139,900 With Falcon ADAS
articles.summary: JETOUR Shanhai L7 PLUS Smart-Driving Edition launches with the Falcon intelligent driving system, priced from RMB 139,900.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the JETOUR Shanhai L7 PLUS Smart-Driving Edition has officially launched, priced from RMB 139,900. The biggest upgrade is the inclusion of the Falcon intelligent driving system. JETOUR, a brand under Chery Holding, focuses on travel-oriented off-road and family mobility segments, and the Shanhai L7 PLUS is a key model in its new-energy lineup. The launch of the Smart-Driving Edition means advanced driver assistance functions are now pushing below the RMB 150,000 price threshold. The Falcon system equips the vehicle with multiple active safety and convenience features, including intelligent driving assistance. In today's market, intelligent driving capability has become a major weight in consumer purchase decisions, and automakers are racing to bring advanced ADAS from models priced above RMB 200,000 down to mainstream price points. JETOUR's entry with a smart-driving edition represents the concrete rollout of Chery Group's broader intelligence strategy in its retail products.
articles.impact: The RMB 139,900 Smart-Driving Edition accelerates the普及 of advanced ADAS at mainstream price points, driving intelligent driving features toward becoming standard in compact new-energy SUVs.

articles.title: BYD Flagship SUV Sea Lion 08 Debut Sparks Buzz as 'BYD's Rolls-Royce'
articles.summary: BYD's 8-series flagship SUV, the Sea Lion 08, has been unveiled with major exterior and interior upgrades, trending on Baidu's hot search.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, BYD's 8-series flagship SUV, the Sea Lion 08, has officially made its public debut. The exterior design was adjusted in response to user feedback, and the interior has been further upgraded in luxury, described as a more upscale flagship offering. Meanwhile, the phrase 'BYD's Rolls-Royce is here' trended on Baidu, reflecting strong market interest in BYD's push into the ultra-premium segment. As the flagship model of BYD's Ocean lineup, the Sea Lion 08 carries the brand's mission to break upward. BYD has previously expanded into million-yuan and high-end personalized markets through its Yangwang and Fangchengbao sub-brands, and this new 8-series flagship SUV further fills out its premium SUV product lineup. Challenging the premium segment has become a defining trend for Chinese brands, and BYD is leveraging its full-stack technology reserves and economies of scale to compete for influence in the global luxury SUV market.
articles.impact: A more complete flagship SUV lineup will strengthen Chinese brands' competitiveness in the global premium SUV market and reshape the landscape of the luxury car segment.

articles.title: Dongfeng Nissan NX7 Static Review: A Stylish Companion for Young Buyers, Comfort Tradition Intact
articles.summary: A static review of the Dongfeng Nissan NX7 has surfaced, highlighting a youth-oriented design while carrying on Nissan's signature sofa-like seat comfort.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the static review of the Dongfeng Nissan NX7 shows the new model positioned as a trendy companion for young buyers, with a design more closely aligned with younger consumers' aesthetic preferences while preserving Nissan's hallmark sofa-grade seat comfort. In the Chinese market, joint-venture brands are facing intense pressure from domestic rivals in the new energy and smart vehicle space, making it a shared challenge for all joint-venture automakers to complete a youth-oriented and localized transformation while retaining traditional strengths. Through the NX7, Dongfeng Nissan hopes to recapture young buyers' attention with a combination of stylish design and comfort. Nissan's long-standing reputation in seat comfort and ride quality remains a differentiating asset, but truly winning over younger consumers will require closing gaps in smart cockpit and intelligent driving capabilities.
articles.impact: The NX7 reflects the youth-focused transformation strategy of joint-venture brands; whether its comfort-based differentiation can translate into sales will serve as a reference point for other joint-venture automakers.

articles.title: NEV Industry Coverage Remains Hot as Specialized Platforms Track Sector Developments Closely
articles.summary: Platforms such as OFweek's New Energy Vehicle site and Sina New Energy continue to update industry news, keeping attention on the sector at a high level.
articles.detail: Based on recent updates from industry news platforms, specialized outlets including OFweek New Energy Vehicle, Sina New Energy, and Autohome's Chejiahao are producing a steady stream of new energy vehicle (NEV) industry news, brand rankings, and pricing data, reflecting the sector's intense level of attention. Their content covers a wide range of topics, including comprehensive NEV brand directories, price listings, and analysis of technology roadmaps, providing decision-making references for both consumers and industry professionals. Notably, multiple platforms are focusing simultaneously on NEV brand landscapes and pricing structures, suggesting the market is at a critical stage of brand differentiation and price reshaping. Globally, the electrification transition continues to advance, and the completeness of China's NEV supply chain and the speed of its technology iteration make its industry developments an important barometer for observers worldwide.
articles.impact: High news density and sustained attention confirm that the NEV industry remains in a period of rapid change, while greater information transparency benefits consumer decision-making.
articles.source: OFweek New Energy Vehicle, Sina Auto

articles.title: Interview: Jiang Ping Says Changan Won't Skimp on Safety — Goal Is to Make Safety Tech Accessible to All
articles.summary: Changan Auto's Jiang Ping stresses in an interview that safety features should not be split between trim levels, calling for broad access to safety technology.
articles.detail: In an interview with NetEase Auto, Changan Auto's Jiang Ping outlined the principle that safety should not vary by trim level, with the aim of making safety technology universally accessible. The remarks come against the backdrop of some automakers differentiating active and passive safety features across trim levels, with base models often seeing significant cuts to safety equipment. Changan's decision to push safety technology as standard across its lineup signals a tilt toward safety over cost. With China's auto market fiercely competitive, safety performance has become a core factor in consumer purchase decisions, and crash test results from bodies like C-IASI are increasingly influencing sales. Changan's move responds to consumer safety demands while also serving as a differentiating strategy to build brand trust amid homogenized competition. If equal access to safety features becomes an industry trend, it would raise the overall safety baseline across the sector.
articles.impact: The push for accessible safety technology could drive parity in safety equipment across the industry, pressuring other automakers to raise safety standards on lower trims — with consumers as the ultimate beneficiaries.

articles.title: Real-World Fuel Test: Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Edition Shows Fuel SUVs Still Competitive on Economy
articles.summary: Real-world fuel consumption results for the Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Edition offer compact SUV buyers a reference point for running costs.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, real-world fuel consumption test results for the Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Edition are in. Blue Whale is Changan's in-house powertrain brand, which has repeatedly set benchmarks in engine thermal efficiency and performance figures, while the CS75 PLUS is a volume driver for Changan in the compact SUV segment. As new energy vehicles penetrate the market aggressively, fuel economy for gasoline and hybrid SUVs directly affects their viability. The test results give consumers a realistic basis for estimating running costs and demonstrate Changan's continued investment in conventional powertrains. The compact SUV segment is among the most competitive in the market, with new energy rivals such as the BYD Song series and Geely Galaxy continuously squeezing the share of fuel SUVs. Fuel economy, purchase price, and resale value remain key variables for the fuel SUV camp to retain buyers.
articles.impact: The fuel economy test provides consumers with real data for vehicle selection and underscores that fuel SUVs remain locked in direct cost competition with new energy models.

articles.title: 1,000km Range Goes Live as Large Five-Seat Electric SUV Race Enters New Phase
articles.summary: Denza N8 opens reservations with 1,003km range, signaling an escalation in premium EV SUV range competition.
articles.detail: Denza N8 has opened reservations with a 1,003km electric range, marking the arrival of 1,000km-class range from the laboratory to mass production and delivery. The move is expected to send ripple effects through the premium electric SUV market. Looking ahead, large five-seat SUVs—the mainstream choice for family buyers—will see fiercer competition combining range, space, and luxury. More automakers are expected to follow with long-range battery solutions, and the rollout of 800V high-voltage platforms and high-energy-density batteries could accelerate. At the same time, the cost pressure from extending range may prompt automakers to adjust pricing. Meanwhile, as models like the Denza N8 enter the market, the price structure of premium electric SUVs could be reshaped, giving consumers richer choices in the RMB 300,000-500,000 range. With the fourth quarter being a peak sales season, automakers' push to hit targets deserves continued attention.
articles.impact: Mass production of 1,000km-range models will accelerate the technology race in premium electric SUVs and drive adoption of battery and fast-charging tech, with consumers as the ultimate beneficiaries.

articles.title: Smart Driving Pushes Downmarket as RMB 100,000-150,000 Segment Becomes Next Battleground
articles.summary: Jetour Shanhai L7 PLUS Smart Driving Edition starts at RMB 139,900, signaling broad rollout of advanced ADAS at mainstream price points.
articles.detail: The Jetour Shanhai L7 PLUS Smart Driving Edition, priced from RMB 139,900 and fitted with the Falcon intelligent driving system, sends a clear signal: advanced autonomous driving is accelerating its descent into the RMB 100,000-150,000 mainstream segment. Together with several other launches today—including the third-generation Qin PLUS DM-i from RMB 76,900, the Binyue Super Power Edition from RMB 59,800, and the Fengyun A9 range-extended version from RMB 116,900—competition in the mainstream market has shifted from a pure price war to a dual contest of price and technology. Looking ahead, smart driving features are poised to become standard equipment on new energy vehicles priced above RMB 100,000, and products lacking such capabilities will face greater pressure. At the same time, as more models offer limited-time trade-in prices and early-bird deals, terminal price competition is expected to heat up further in the fourth quarter. When shopping, consumers should pay close attention to each model's smart driving hardware readiness and future upgrade capability.
articles.impact: The spread of smart driving features to mainstream price points will reshape purchase decision criteria, while fourth-quarter price and technology competition runs in parallel, giving consumers greater room for savings.
